description: List keys with optional prefix, tag, or since (updated_at) filter. Returns keys + timestamps + tags only — call memory_get for values. Scoped by DELX_MEMORY_NAMESPACE when set.

prefix.description: Only return keys starting with this string.

privacy_mode.description: summary = keys/meta without full values; structured/raw = full entries (local store parity).

since.description: Unix ms — only keys with updated_at >= since (session resume / delta sync).

tag.description: Only return keys carrying this tag.

name: memory_list
